products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination and servicing of fixed and adjustable-rate mortgage loans for owner-occupied and non-owner occupied 1-4 family residences, including first-time homebuyer programs and construction-to-permanent loans. Loans are originated primarily through in-person representatives and retained in the bank's portfolio.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of fixed and adjustable-rate mortgage loans secured by multi-family, mixed-use, industrial-warehouse, and other commercial properties, with active portfolio management and underwriting focused on cash flow and collateral value. Loans may be originated or purchased, including outside the primary market area.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Origination of commercial business loans secured by inventory, business assets, equipment, receivables, or real estate, with terms up to 20 years and both fixed and adjustable rates. Underwriting focuses on borrower creditworthiness and cash flow.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provision of direct loans for new and used automobiles, personal loans (secured or unsecured), home equity loans and lines of credit, and other consumer installment loans. Loans are underwritten internally and may be secured by various collateral.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offering a variety of deposit accounts including savings, NOW accounts, money market accounts, certificates of deposit, noninterest-bearing checking accounts, and IRAs to retail and municipal customers. Includes participation in brokered and reciprocal deposit networks for enhanced FDIC insurance.

products.name: Municipal Banking Services
products.description: Provision of deposit and banking services to local municipalities, including accepting deposits from government entities and providing collateralization through securities and letters of credit. Offered primarily through Greene County Commercial Bank.

products.name: Investment and Wealth Management Services
products.description: Offering alternative investment products and wealth management services to customers through a third-party partnership (Osaic Institutions, Inc.), rebranded as Greene Investment Services. Delivered via a dedicated wealth management center.

products.name: Merchant Bankcard Services
products.description: Installation, maintenance, and servicing of merchant bankcard equipment for local retailers, with the bank earning a percentage of transaction volume processed through such equipment.

products.name: Deposit Account and Card Fee Services
products.description: Collection of service charges, ATM fees, debit card fees, and other related fees on deposit accounts and card transactions. Includes income from overdrafts and late payment charges.

products.name: Securities Investment Portfolio Management
products.description: Investment in and management of a portfolio of securities including U.S. government and agency securities, municipal bonds, mortgage-backed securities, and corporate debt, primarily for interest income, liquidity, and collateral purposes. Securities are managed for risk, liquidity, and yield.

products.name: Senior Housing Communities
products.description: Ownership and investment in senior housing communities, including independent living, assisted living, memory care, and continuing care retirement communities. These are operated by third-party managers or directly, require physical real estate assets, and are subject to healthcare regulations.

products.name: Outpatient Medical Buildings and Research Centers
products.description: Acquisition, ownership, development, leasing, and management of outpatient medical buildings and research centers, which are specialized real estate assets leased to healthcare providers, universities, and research organizations. Delivery involves property management, leasing, and facility development services.

products.name: Triple-Net Leased Healthcare Facilities
products.description: Investment in and ownership of healthcare facilities—including senior housing, skilled nursing facilities, long-term acute care, inpatient rehabilitation, and other healthcare facilities—leased to operators under triple-net or absolute-net leases. Delivery is through real estate ownership and leasing, not direct operation.

products.name: Loans Receivable and Real Estate Investments
products.description: Provision of loans and investments secured by real estate or other collateral, including mortgage and mezzanine loans, to third-party operators and entities. This is a financial service involving capital deployment and risk management, not direct property operation.

products.name: Institutional Private Capital Management Platform
products.description: Management of third-party institutional capital through joint ventures and investment vehicles, partnering with institutional investors to invest in healthcare real estate. Services include acting as sponsor or general partner and earning management and incentive fees.

products.name: Customer Engagement and Loyalty Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based software platforms that provide customer engagement, loyalty programs, marketing, digital ordering, and personalized offers for restaurants and retailers. Delivered as SaaS and integrated across web, mobile, and in-store channels, leveraging AI and data analytics.

products.name: Point-of-Sale (POS) Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based and on-premise POS software and hardware platforms for restaurants and retailers, including integration with kiosks, kitchen systems, and reporting tools. Delivered as SaaS and through durable hardware terminals and tablets designed for foodservice environments.

products.name: Payment Processing Solutions
products.description: Comprehensive electronic payment processing services and gateway technology enabling acceptance of various payment methods (credit, debit, contactless, mobile, digital wallets, gift cards) for restaurants and retailers. Delivered as SaaS and integrated with POS systems.

products.name: Operational Intelligence and Business Analytics Solutions
products.description: Cloud-based software platforms that aggregate and analyze operational data (POS, inventory, supply, payroll, accounting) to provide actionable insights, dashboards, and automation for restaurant and retail operations. Delivered as SaaS and integrated with other systems.

products.name: Drive-Thru and Wireless Communication Systems
products.description: Manufactured wireless headsets, drive-thru timer systems, and related hardware for restaurant drive-thru operations, providing real-time feedback and communication tools to improve service speed and efficiency.

products.name: In-Store Peripherals and Payment Devices
products.description: A range of hardware peripherals such as payment devices, cash drawers, printers, and kitchen display systems, sourced from partners and integrated into comprehensive in-store technology solutions for restaurants and retailers.

products.name: Professional Services (Installation, Support, Training, Repair)
products.description: A portfolio of services including hardware repair, installation and implementation, application and technical training, and on-site and remote technical support for customers using PAR's technology solutions. Delivered through field service networks and support centers.

products.name: Auto Insurance Brokerage Services
products.description: Roadzen acts as an insurance broker, distributing auto insurance policies from multiple insurers through embedded and B2B2C channels, leveraging its technology platform for digital policy sales, underwriting, and claims management. The service is delivered via regulated entities and licensed platforms in key markets, generating commission-based revenue.

products.name: Insurance as a Service (IaaS) Technology Platform
products.description: A unified, cloud-based platform providing insurers, OEMs, and fleets with AI-powered modules for underwriting, policy administration, claims processing, telematics, and road safety. The platform is sold as a SaaS solution, with usage-based pricing, and includes modules for vehicle inspection, claims automation, driver scoring, and advanced driver-assistance.

products.name: Claims Management Services
products.description: Digital, AI-driven claims management solutions for insurers, fleets, and OEMs, including touchless claims processing, accident scene management, remote vehicle inspection, and integration with repair and roadside assistance networks. Delivered via proprietary platforms such as xClaim and StrandD, these services automate and streamline the claims lifecycle.

products.name: Roadside Assistance (RSA) Services
products.description: Comprehensive roadside assistance services for commercial and consumer vehicles, including towing, emergency response, accident management, and digital dispatch, delivered through a network of service providers and integrated with claims and telematics platforms. Offered as a white-labeled solution to insurers, OEMs, and fleets.

products.name: Telematics and Driver Safety Solutions
products.description: AI-powered telematics solutions for insurers, fleets, and OEMs, including driver behavior monitoring, usage-based insurance (UBI), fleet safety analytics, and advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS). Delivered via software SDKs, connected vehicle integrations, and dashcam hardware (DrivebuddyAI), these solutions enable real-time risk assessment and driver coaching.

products.name: Extended Warranty and Specialty Insurance Programs
products.description: Distribution and administration of extended vehicle warranties and specialty insurance products, leveraging data-driven customization and integration with OEMs, dealerships, and fleets. These programs are managed through Roadzen’s MGA and brokerage platforms, with risk underwritten by partner insurers and reinsurers.

products.name: Crude Oil Production and Sales
products.description: Exploration, development, and production of crude oil from company-operated wells in the Midland Basin, primarily using horizontal drilling and hydraulic fracturing. Crude oil is transported via pipeline or truck and sold under long-term contracts to third-party purchasers.

products.name: Natural Gas Production and Sales
products.description: Exploration, development, and production of natural gas from company-operated wells in the Midland Basin, with gas gathered and processed by third-party processors and sold to multiple third-party purchasers under processing and purchase contracts.

products.name: Natural Gas Liquids (NGL) Production and Sales
products.description: Production of natural gas liquids as a byproduct of natural gas processing, with NGLs extracted by third-party processors and sold to external customers.

products.name: Medical X-ray Imaging Components
products.description: Design, manufacture, and sale of X-ray tubes, flat panel and photon counting detectors, high voltage connectors, generators, coolers, and accessories for use in medical imaging equipment. These are physical components produced in regulated manufacturing facilities and sold primarily to OEMs for integration into diagnostic and therapeutic medical systems.

products.name: Medical Imaging Software Solutions
products.description: Development and licensing of image-processing software, 3D reconstruction software, computer-aided diagnostic software, and automatic exposure control software for medical imaging applications. Delivered as digital products, often integrated with hardware components or sold as software licenses with maintenance.

products.name: Replacement Parts and Service for Medical Imaging Components
products.description: Provision of replacement X-ray tubes, detectors, and other imaging components, as well as service and support for installed medical imaging equipment. Involves manufacturing, logistics, and in-person technical support.

products.name: Industrial X-ray Imaging Components
products.description: Design, manufacture, and sale of X-ray tubes, flat panel and photon counting detectors, high voltage connectors, and coolers for industrial imaging applications such as non-destructive testing, quality inspection, and analysis. These are physical components produced in certified facilities and sold to OEMs and system integrators.

products.name: Industrial X-ray Imaging Systems
products.description: Manufacture and sale of complete X-ray imaging systems for industrial applications, including non-intrusive cargo inspection systems and computed radiography scanners. These are stand-alone systems assembled from in-house components and delivered to end-users or integrators.

products.name: X-ray Linear Accelerators (Linatron®)
products.description: Design, manufacture, and sale of high-energy X-ray linear accelerators, primarily for industrial and security applications such as cargo screening and irradiation. These are complex, regulated physical devices requiring specialized manufacturing and service.

products.name: Industrial Imaging Software Solutions
products.description: Development and licensing of proprietary image-processing and detection software for industrial X-ray imaging applications, often bundled with hardware components or systems. Delivered as digital products to OEMs and system integrators.

products.name: Replacement Parts and Service for Industrial Imaging Components and Systems
products.description: Provision of replacement parts, upgrades, and long-term service agreements for installed industrial X-ray imaging components and systems, including Linatron® accelerators. Involves manufacturing, logistics, and technical support services.

products.name: Small Molecule Therapeutics for Oncology and Other Diseases
products.description: Discovery and development of small molecule drugs, primarily kinase inhibitors, targeting validated biological mechanisms in diseases such as chronic myeloid leukemia (CML), HER2+ cancers, and other conditions with unmet medical need. These therapeutics are produced through proprietary medicinal chemistry and are delivered as orally administered pharmaceuticals, manufactured by third-party contract organizations.

products.name: Citrus Fruit Sales
products.description: Production and sale of citrus fruit, primarily oranges, to processed and fresh citrus markets. This involves owning, cultivating, and harvesting citrus groves, with fruit delivered to customers such as juice processors. Operations require physical agricultural labor, land management, and compliance with agricultural regulations.

products.name: Land Leasing (Grazing, Farming, Hunting, Conservation, Mining)
products.description: Leasing of land for various external uses including grazing, farming, hunting, conservation, and mining. This business line involves managing and leasing unimproved and improved land to third parties for agricultural, recreational, and resource extraction purposes, generating recurring lease and royalty income.

products.name: Land Sales and Development
products.description: Sale and strategic development of land holdings, including ranch and citrus land, as part of a long-term real estate development strategy. This involves identifying surplus land, preparing it for sale or development, and executing transactions with external buyers or partners. Requires expertise in land management, entitlement, and real estate transactions.

products.name: Antifibrotic Therapies for Pulmonary Fibrosis
products.description: Small-molecule therapies, including pirfenidone (ETUARY®) and nintedanib (Etolel®), manufactured and commercialized for the treatment of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) and related fibrotic lung diseases. These are produced via chemical synthesis, formulated as oral capsules, and distributed through a regulated pharmaceutical supply chain.

products.name: Thrombopoietin Receptor Agonist for Hematologic Conditions
products.description: Oral small-molecule therapy (avatrombopag, branded as Contiva®) for the treatment of thrombocytopenia associated with chronic liver disease and chronic idiopathic thrombocytopenia. Manufactured as tablets and distributed to hospitals and pharmacies.

products.name: Liver Fibrosis Therapies (Development Pipeline)
products.description: Small-molecule therapies in clinical development, including Hydronidone (F351), targeting liver fibrosis due to chronic hepatitis B (CHB) and metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH). These are chemically synthesized and delivered as oral medications, with manufacturing under cGMP standards.

products.name: Acute Liver Failure Therapies (Development Pipeline)
products.description: Clinical-stage small-molecule therapy (F573), a caspase inhibitor designed to reduce hepatocyte apoptosis and mitigate severe liver injury in acute liver failure (ALF) and acute-on-chronic liver failure (ACLF). Manufactured for injection and evaluated in clinical trials.

products.name: Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension Therapy (Development Pipeline)
products.description: Clinical-stage small-molecule therapy (F230), a selective endothelin receptor A antagonist for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH). Developed as an oral medication and currently in clinical trials.

products.name: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease Therapy (Development Pipeline)
products.description: Preclinical-stage small-molecule anti-inflammatory compound (F528) designed to inhibit multiple inflammatory cytokines for the treatment of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). Developed for oral administration, with manufacturing and clinical development planned.

products.name: Battery Solutions for Electric Commercial Vehicles
products.description: Designs, develops, and manufactures high-performance lithium-ion battery systems for light, medium, and heavy-duty trucks, buses, trains, mining trucks, marine and port vehicles, automated guided vehicles, and specialty vehicles. These systems are physically manufactured and delivered to OEMs, integrating proprietary cell chemistries, modules, packs, thermal management, and battery management systems.

products.name: Energy Storage Systems (ESS)
products.description: Manufactures and delivers large-scale lithium-ion battery-based energy storage systems for commercial and industrial customers, supporting grid infrastructure, capacity support, and grid resiliency. These systems are physically produced and deployed as containerized solutions, leveraging proprietary battery technologies.

products.name: Battery Components (Cathode, Anode, Electrolyte, Separator)
products.description: Develops, manufactures, and sells proprietary battery cell components—including cathodes, anodes, electrolytes, and separators—to other battery manufacturers and OEMs. These are physically produced materials, leveraging in-house intellectual property and manufacturing capacity.

products.name: Battery Management Systems (BMS)
products.description: Designs and supplies proprietary battery management systems that control, monitor, and optimize battery performance, safety, and longevity for commercial vehicle and ESS applications. These are digital and hardware systems integrated into battery solutions or sold as part of the overall system.

products.name: Service, Repairs, and Extended Warranties
products.description: Provides after-sales services including maintenance, repairs, and warranty support (including extended warranties) for battery systems sold to customers. These services are delivered through in-person human labor and technical support.

products.name: Gas Utility Infrastructure Services
products.description: Comprehensive maintenance, replacement, repair, and installation services for local natural gas distribution utilities, focused on modernizing and upgrading gas infrastructure. Delivered through skilled field labor and in-house fabrication, primarily under long-term service agreements.

products.name: Electric Utility Infrastructure Services
products.description: Comprehensive maintenance, replacement, repair, upgrade, and expansion services for electric utility distribution and urban transmission infrastructure, including both union and non-union markets. Services focus on infrastructure between substations and end-user meters, delivered via recurring contracts and skilled labor.

products.name: Renewable Energy Infrastructure Construction
products.description: Construction and installation of electrical systems used in renewable energy projects, supporting the integration of distributed power and renewable sources into utility networks. Delivered through specialized construction teams and project management.

products.name: Storm Response and Restoration Services
products.description: Emergency response and restoration services for utility infrastructure following severe weather events, including rapid mobilization of crews and equipment to restore above-ground electric and gas networks. Delivered as needed, often resulting in higher equipment utilization.

products.name: Other Underground Utility Services (Water and Fiber)
products.description: Installation, maintenance, and repair services for underground water and fiber utility infrastructure, leveraging expertise in underground construction and in-house fabrication capabilities. Delivered alongside core gas and electric services.

products.name: Heavy Industrial and Fabrication Services
products.description: Provision of heavy industrial services including civil, mechanical, electrical, and fabrication (component assembly) work, primarily for utility and energy sector clients. Delivered through specialized teams and in-house fabrication facilities.

products.name: IT Consulting Services
products.description: Provision of high-value, high-margin IT consulting solutions, including strategy, implementation, and support, delivered by expert teams for both commercial and federal government clients. Services are delivered through time-and-materials, fixed-price, and cost reimbursable contracts, leveraging a deep talent pool and proprietary assets.

products.name: IT Staffing and Assignment Services
products.description: Provision of experienced IT and creative digital marketing professionals for temporary assignments and project engagements, including contract and permanent placements, to meet clients' specialized technical and creative needs. Delivered through a flexible, just-in-time staffing model.

products.name: Cloud and Infrastructure Solutions
products.description: Consulting, implementation, and management of cloud computing and IT infrastructure solutions, including partnerships with hyperscalers like AWS, Microsoft, and Google. Delivered through both commercial and government contracts, requiring technical expertise and certifications.

products.name: Data and AI Solutions
products.description: Advanced data analytics, artificial intelligence, and machine learning solutions, including consulting, development, and deployment for commercial and federal clients. Delivered by certified professionals, often requiring security clearances for government work.

products.name: Software Development and Engineering Services
products.description: Custom software development, engineering, and digital product creation for clients across industries, leveraging proprietary accelerators and industry expertise. Delivered by specialized teams under various contract models.

products.name: Cybersecurity Solutions
products.description: Comprehensive cybersecurity consulting, implementation, and managed services, including risk assessment, security modernization, and compliance for commercial and federal clients. Delivered by certified consultants, many with security clearances.

products.name: Enterprise Platforms Solutions
products.description: Consulting, integration, and management of enterprise software platforms such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, and Workday, including platform customization and workflow automation for clients. Delivered through partnerships and certified professionals.

products.name: Customer Experience Solutions
products.description: Design and implementation of digital customer experience solutions, including creative digital marketing and user experience optimization, delivered by specialized professionals for commercial clients.

products.name: Online Marketplace Platform
products.description: A global digital platform that connects buyers and sellers, enabling transactions of a wide variety of goods and services through web and mobile interfaces. The platform is powered by proprietary technology, AI-driven features, and supports both consumer-to-consumer and business-to-consumer commerce.

products.name: Advertising Solutions
products.description: Digital advertising services offered to sellers to promote their listings and increase visibility within the eBay marketplace, utilizing data-driven tools and dashboards to optimize performance.

products.name: Integrated Shipping Solutions
products.description: Shipping and logistics services provided in partnership with third parties, offering integrated shipping options, delivery transparency, and cross-border shipping support for marketplace transactions.

products.name: Seller Financial Services
products.description: Financial services for sellers, including working capital loans and flexible payment options, delivered through partnerships and proprietary programs to support small business growth on the platform.

products.name: Authentication and Grading Services
products.description: Authentication and grading services for high-value, collectible, and luxury items, including trading cards and luxury goods, provided through partnerships and proprietary programs to enhance buyer trust and transparency.

products.name: Charity Commerce Platform
products.description: A platform feature that enables buyers and sellers to support charitable organizations through their transactions, facilitating donations and fundraising via the eBay marketplace.

products.name: Audio Components
products.description: Integrated circuits such as amplifiers, codecs, smart codecs, analog-to-digital converters, digital-to-analog converters, and standalone digital signal processors, manufactured using third-party foundries and delivered as hardware components for integration into consumer electronics.

products.name: Audio Software and Algorithms
products.description: Software tools and algorithms, including SoundClear technology, provided as embedded software or IP to enhance audio quality, playback, voice capture, and hearing augmentation in customer devices.

products.name: High-Performance Mixed-Signal (HPMS) Components
products.description: Integrated circuits for camera controllers, haptics and sensing solutions, and battery and power ICs, manufactured via third-party foundries and delivered as hardware for smartphones, automotive, industrial, and imaging applications.

products.name: Prepress Solutions
products.description: Manufactures and sells digital offset printing plates and computer-to-plate (CTP) imaging equipment for commercial printers, with recurring revenue from plate sales. Production involves physical manufacturing of aluminum plates and imaging equipment, delivered through direct and indirect sales channels.

products.name: Inkjet Printing Systems and Consumables
products.description: Produces and sells inkjet press systems (PROSPER), print head components, and related consumables such as inks and primers for commercial, publishing, packaging, and décor applications. Products are physically manufactured and delivered to customers, with recurring revenue from consumables and service.

products.name: Print Production Workflow Software
products.description: Develops and licenses software solutions for print production workflow, including automation, web integration, and digital front-end controllers, delivered digitally or as part of integrated print systems to commercial print and packaging customers.

products.name: Electrophotographic Printing Consumables and Services
products.description: Provides consumables (such as toner and ink) and ongoing service for installed electrophotographic printers (e.g., NEXFINITY), following the cessation of new printer manufacturing. Delivery involves physical consumables and technical service to existing customers.

products.name: Industrial Film and Chemicals
products.description: Manufactures and sells professional and consumer still photographic film, industrial films (including for electronics and printed circuit boards), specialty chemicals, solvent recovery, polyester film, and specialty inks and dispersions. Products are physically manufactured and distributed directly or through dealers.

products.name: Coating and Product Commercialization Services
products.description: Provides contract manufacturing and commercialization services for third-party products, utilizing Kodak’s roll-to-roll coating capabilities for pilot and production scale, including coated substrates for batteries and other applications. Delivered as a service using Kodak’s manufacturing infrastructure.

products.name: Motion Picture Film and Processing Services
products.description: Produces and sells motion picture film to the entertainment industry and provides film processing services at dedicated laboratories. Involves physical manufacturing and in-person processing services for studios and filmmakers.

products.name: Pharmaceutical Ingredients and Diagnostic Reagents
products.description: Manufactures unregulated key starting materials (KSMs) for pharmaceuticals and diagnostic test reagent solutions, including phosphate buffered saline (PBS), using cGMP-certified facilities. Products are physically manufactured and supplied to healthcare and laboratory customers.

products.name: Advanced Materials and Functional Printing Solutions
products.description: Develops and manufactures advanced materials (e.g., smart materials, functional films) and provides contract manufacturing and development partnerships for high-resolution micro-3D printing solutions, such as printed electronics and transparent heaters. Delivered as physical products or through development services.

products.name: Intellectual Property Licensing and Analytical Services
products.description: Licenses Kodak’s patents and technology to third parties and provides analytical laboratory services to external clients. Revenue is generated through licensing agreements and service fees.

products.name: Brand Licensing
products.description: Licenses the Kodak brand to third parties for use on products such as cameras, consumer printing devices, eyewear, batteries, and apparel, generating royalty streams and upfront payments. Delivered through contractual agreements with licensees.

products.name: Customer Experience (CX) Solutions and Services
products.description: End-to-end solutions that optimize and manage the customer lifecycle, including acquisition, support, and renewal, delivered through a combination of human labor and digital technologies across multiple communication channels (voice, chat, email, social media, AI-powered self-service).

products.name: Digital Operations Services
products.description: Business process outsourcing services leveraging human and AI capabilities to deliver marketing, B2B sales, customer service, trust and safety, collections, and financial compliance, delivered at scale through global service centers and remote staff.

products.name: Strategy and Design Consulting
products.description: Consulting services focused on business transformation, experience design, and digital innovation, using human-centered design and technology to shape client strategies and operations, typically delivered by expert consultants and design engineers.

products.name: Data and Analytics Services
products.description: Technology-enabled services that transform, annotate, and analyze enterprise data to provide actionable insights, advanced analytics, and operational intelligence, delivered through proprietary platforms and analytics professionals.

products.name: Enterprise Technology Services
products.description: Advisory, development, integration, and management of enterprise-wide applications, including self-service AI bots, GenAI-powered platforms, quality assurance, testing, and managed cybersecurity, delivered by technology professionals and supported by proprietary and third-party tools.

products.name: Intelligent Experience (iX) Suite Products
products.description: Proprietary GenAI and agentic AI-powered software products (e.g., iX Hello, iX Hero) that enable customizable virtual assistants, real-time coaching, conversation analysis, and automation of business functions, delivered as enterprise-grade digital applications.

products.name: Agentic Operating Framework Services
products.description: Consulting and technology services that help enterprises implement and manage agentic AI solutions, including readiness assessment, strategy, engineering, data management, and monitoring, delivered through a combination of proprietary frameworks and expert consulting.

products.name: Canadian Cannabis Products
products.description: Cultivation, processing, and sale of recreational and medicinal cannabis products (including dried flower, pre-rolls, oils, edibles, extracts, and topicals) produced in large-scale controlled environment agriculture (CEA) greenhouses and indoor facilities, distributed across Canada and exported to select international markets. Products are delivered through provincial distributors, retail stores, and direct-to-retail channels.

products.name: Third-Party Cannabis Commercialization Services (Quebec)
products.description: Sales, marketing, and distribution services for third-party cannabis brands and micro/craft growers in Quebec, leveraging regulatory expertise and direct-to-retail relationships to commercialize and distribute cannabis products throughout the province.

products.name: U.S. Hemp-Derived CBD and Cannabinoid Wellness Products
products.description: Development, manufacturing, and sale of hemp-derived CBD and other cannabinoid-based health and wellness products (including oils, ingestibles, edibles, and topicals), primarily distributed through a proprietary e-commerce platform and retail channels in the United States. Products are manufactured using non-GMO hemp, advanced extraction, and cGMP-certified bottling and packaging.

products.name: Netherlands Recreational Cannabis Products
products.description: Cultivation and supply of legal, quality-controlled recreational cannabis (flower, pre-rolls, hash, and edibles made from raw cannabis) to designated Dutch coffee shops under the Controlled Cannabis Supply Chain Experiment, produced in licensed indoor facilities and distributed exclusively to participating municipalities.

products.name: Fresh Greenhouse-Grown Tomatoes
products.description: Production and sale of fresh, premium-quality tomatoes grown year-round in controlled environment agriculture (CEA) greenhouses in British Columbia, using hydroponic and sustainable methods. Products are sold wholesale to retail supermarkets and food distributors through a sales and marketing agreement with a third-party distributor.

products.name: Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) Royalty Revenue
products.description: Receipt of royalty revenue from the production and sale of renewable natural gas (RNG) generated by a partner-operated facility that captures and purifies landfill methane gas at the Delta, B.C. landfill site, converting it into pipeline-quality RNG for sale to energy markets.

products.name: Industrial-Scale HPC Data Center Leasing
products.description: Development, construction, and long-term leasing of turnkey, industrial-scale data centers purpose-built for high-performance computing (HPC) workloads, primarily for hyperscaler and enterprise tenants. These facilities require physical site acquisition, power origination, modular construction, and ongoing facility operations.

products.name: Bitcoin Mining Operations
products.description: Operation of energy-intensive data centers that purchase electricity to run specialized mining hardware, contributing computing power to mining pools in exchange for bitcoin rewards and transaction fees. This business requires physical infrastructure, power procurement, and ongoing facility management.

products.name: Wholesale Power Sales
products.description: Sale of surplus purchased electrical power from data center sites back to the wholesale power market when not used for bitcoin mining or data center operations. This involves financial transactions and energy market participation, leveraging existing power purchase agreements.

products.name: Competitive Mobile Gaming Platform
products.description: A proprietary multi-player platform that enables game developers to integrate real-money tournaments, virtual prizes, and social competition features into their mobile games. Delivered as a managed backend and SDK, it provides player matching, leaderboards, anti-cheat systems, payment processing, and analytics, supporting both Android and iOS games.

products.name: Performance Marketing and Advertising Platform (RZR)
products.description: An AI-powered advertising technology platform that delivers performance marketing solutions for brands and mobile apps, including user acquisition, retargeting, and campaign optimization across mobile, connected television, and other digital channels. Utilizes proprietary machine learning and real-time data processing to optimize ad campaigns.

products.name: Published and Owned Mobile Game Titles
products.description: Select mobile game titles published and operated directly by Skillz, shared with the broader ecosystem and monetized through the Skillz platform. These games are distributed via app stores and direct downloads, leveraging the company's competition and monetization infrastructure.

products.name: Fragrance Products
products.description: Manufactured and marketed fragrances across mass, premium, and ultra-premium price points, produced in company-owned and third-party facilities, and distributed globally through multiple retail channels.

products.name: Color Cosmetics
products.description: A range of color cosmetic products (such as makeup) produced in company and third-party facilities, distributed through mass and prestige retail channels, and supported by digital and in-store marketing.

products.name: Skin and Body Care Products
products.description: Skin and body care products, including skincare and body mists, manufactured in dedicated facilities and distributed through mass and prestige channels, with a strategic focus on innovation and sustainability.

products.name: MEPC Systems Design, Construction, and Upgrades
products.description: Comprehensive design, engineering, installation, and upgrade of mechanical (heating, ventilation, air conditioning), electrical, plumbing, and controls systems for complex facilities, delivered through both new construction and retrofit projects. Requires significant engineering expertise, field labor, and project management, typically under fixed-price or time and materials contracts.

products.name: Service and Maintenance of Building Systems
products.description: Ongoing inspection, troubleshooting, repair, and preventative maintenance services for building systems, including 24/7 emergency response, predictive maintenance, and tailored maintenance contracts. Delivered by skilled technicians through recurring service agreements and on-demand work.

products.name: Integrated Facility Planning and Consulting
products.description: Professional and consultative services to building owners, including facility assessments, capital planning, program management, and engineering-led analysis to align facility needs with business goals. Delivered by engineering and consulting teams, often as part of long-term partnerships.

products.name: Rental Equipment Solutions
products.description: Turnkey rental of mechanical and electrical equipment to support building owners during planned replacements, emergency repairs, and construction outages, including system design, installation, maintenance, and removal. Delivered as a managed service beyond simple equipment supply.

products.name: Energy Efficiency and Decarbonization Solutions
products.description: Customized consulting and project delivery to help building owners achieve energy and carbon reduction goals, including facility benchmarking, energy-efficient equipment upgrades, sourcing of rebates and incentives, and long-term decarbonization roadmaps. Delivered by energy engineers and project teams.

products.name: General Contractor MEPC Project Delivery
products.description: Management and execution of MEPC systems projects for new construction or renovation, awarded by general contractors or construction managers, using plan & spec bidding or design/build methodologies. Involves project management, engineering, and field labor under competitive or negotiated contracts.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by non-farm, non-residential properties such as hotels, office buildings, healthcare facilities, retail stores, warehouses, and other commercial buildings. These loans are physically originated, underwritten, and serviced by the bank, often requiring property appraisals and personal guarantees.

products.name: Commercial and Industrial Lending
products.description: Provision of loans and lines of credit to small and mid-sized businesses, including asset-based lending, term loans, and participation in government-guaranteed programs (SBA, USDA). These loans are originated and serviced by the bank and typically secured by business assets or equipment.

products.name: Syndicated and Shared National Credits
products.description: Participation in syndicated loans with other financial institutions, primarily to large and middle market companies, secured by business assets or commercial real estate. These are structured, underwritten, and serviced in partnership with other banks.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination of one- to four-family residential real estate loans, including conforming and jumbo mortgages, home equity lines of credit, and construction loans for individuals. These are physically originated, underwritten, and serviced by the bank, often held in portfolio.

products.name: Multifamily Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by multifamily properties, such as apartment buildings, with underwriting similar to commercial real estate loans. These loans are physically originated and serviced by the bank.

products.name: Construction and Land Development Lending
products.description: Provision of loans to finance the construction of commercial and residential properties and land development, with funds disbursed as projects progress. These loans are physically originated, underwritten, and serviced by the bank.

products.name: Agricultural Lending
products.description: Origination of loans to farmers and agribusinesses for crop cultivation, livestock, and equipment, often secured by crops or farm assets and sometimes guaranteed by the U.S. Farm Service Agency. These loans are physically originated and serviced by the bank.

products.name: Farmland Lending
products.description: Origination of first mortgage loans secured by farmland, with terms up to 40 years and sometimes guaranteed by the U.S. Farm Service Agency. These loans are physically originated and serviced by the bank.

products.name: Commercial Leasing
products.description: Provision of lease financing for commercial equipment and assets, sourced through third parties and secured by the leased equipment. The bank underwrites, funds, and services these leases.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Origination of secured and unsecured consumer loans, including loans collateralized by deposits, vehicles, and boats, as well as unsecured personal loans. These are physically originated and serviced by the bank.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offering a variety of deposit accounts to consumers, businesses, and municipalities, including checking, savings, money market, and time deposits. These are managed through physical branches and digital channels, and include specialized public funds deposit programs.

products.name: Treasury Management and Business Banking Services
products.description: Provision of business banking solutions such as merchant services, ACH origination, lockbox services, remote deposit capture, and Autobooks for small businesses. These services are delivered through digital and in-person channels.

products.name: Consumer Banking Services
products.description: Provision of consumer banking services including credit cards, mobile deposit capture, safe deposit boxes, official checks, and ATM access. These services are delivered through physical branches and digital platforms.

products.name: Investment Securities Sales
products.description: Investment of bank assets in securities such as U.S. government and agency obligations, municipal bonds, corporate debt, mutual funds, and mortgage-backed securities. These investments are managed by the bank for income and liquidity, not sold to external customers.

products.name: Video Games and Interactive Entertainment Software
products.description: Development, marketing, publishing, and delivery of digital interactive entertainment software across consoles, PCs, and mobile devices. Products are created using creative talent, production capabilities, and a broad portfolio of owned and licensed intellectual property, and are distributed digitally and through retail channels.

products.name: Live Services and Extra Content
products.description: Ongoing digital services that extend and enhance gameplay, including extra content, in-game purchases, and subscription offerings. Delivered digitally through game platforms and storefronts, these services are designed to provide value and deepen player engagement.

products.name: Subscription Services for Games
products.description: Subscription-based access to a portfolio of games and services, available on consoles, PCs, and mobile devices. Delivered digitally via EA’s own app and third-party platforms, allowing players to access multiple games for a recurring fee.

products.name: Mobile Free-to-Play Games
products.description: Development and distribution of free-to-play mobile games, monetized through in-app purchases and extra content. Distributed via third-party application storefronts such as Apple and Google, as well as through publishing partners in certain countries.

products.name: Retail Banking Services
products.description: Provides a wide range of consumer banking products and services, including deposit accounts, consumer loans, and ATM access, primarily through a network of domestic banking offices and ATMs. Delivery requires regulated infrastructure and in-person and digital channels.

products.name: Commercial Banking Services
products.description: Offers financial services to small and medium-sized businesses, including business loans, deposit accounts, and treasury management, delivered through physical branches and relationship managers. Requires regulated infrastructure and in-person human labor.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending and Loan Servicing
products.description: Provides commercial mortgage loans secured by income-producing properties and offers multifamily real estate lending and loan servicing, primarily through specialized subsidiaries. Requires financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Equipment Leasing and Financing
products.description: Provides equipment leasing and financing solutions to business customers through specialized subsidiaries, involving financial capital and asset management expertise.

products.name: Wealth Management Services
products.description: Offers wealth management solutions including investment management, financial planning, and advisory services to high-net-worth individuals and families, delivered through dedicated advisors and digital platforms.

products.name: Trust and Fiduciary Services
products.description: Provides trust administration and fiduciary services for individuals and institutional clients, including estate planning and asset management, delivered through specialized trust companies and regulated entities.

products.name: Institutional Brokerage and Securities Services
products.description: Offers institutional brokerage and securities services, including trade execution and investment products, through a registered broker-dealer subsidiary. Delivered digitally and via licensed professionals.

products.name: KFC Restaurants
products.description: Quick-service restaurants offering fried chicken, burgers, rice dishes, congees, desserts, coffee, tea, and other menu items, delivered through dine-in, delivery, and takeaway channels. Requires physical restaurant operations, supply chain management, and digital ordering infrastructure.

products.name: Pizza Hut Restaurants
products.description: Casual dining restaurants providing pizzas, pasta, steaks, rice dishes, burgers, appetizers, beverages, and desserts, served via dine-in, delivery, takeaway, and packaged foods for at-home consumption. Involves physical restaurant operations, supply chain, and digital ordering systems.

products.name: Lavazza Coffee Shops and Retail Coffee Products
products.description: Coffee shops offering Italian-style coffee and related beverages, and retail sales of packaged coffee products through both Lavazza-branded stores and external retail channels. Delivered via physical coffee shops and retail distribution.

products.name: Huang Ji Huang Restaurants
products.description: Franchised simmer pot restaurants specializing in Chinese-style simmer pot cuisine, primarily operated through a franchise model. Requires physical restaurant locations and supply chain for specialty ingredients.

products.name: Little Sheep Restaurants
products.description: Franchised hot pot restaurants specializing in Chinese hot pot cuisine, operated mainly through franchisees. Involves physical restaurant operations and supply of specialty hot pot ingredients.

products.name: Taco Bell Restaurants
products.description: Quick-service restaurants offering Mexican-style food such as tacos, burritos, quesadillas, salads, and nachos, delivered through dine-in, delivery, and takeaway. Requires physical restaurant operations and supply chain for Mexican cuisine ingredients.

products.name: Food Delivery Services
products.description: Delivery of food and beverages from company-owned and franchised restaurants to customers via proprietary digital platforms and third-party aggregators, utilizing both dedicated and platform riders. Relies on digital infrastructure and logistics network.

products.name: Packaged and Retail Food Products
products.description: Packaged foods and ready-to-eat products sold for at-home consumption, including items from Pizza Hut and Lavazza, distributed through restaurants and retail channels. Involves food manufacturing, packaging, and retail logistics.

products.name: Seasoning Products for Franchisees
products.description: Manufacture and sale of proprietary seasoning products to Huang Ji Huang and Little Sheep franchisees, produced in company-owned facilities. Involves food manufacturing and B2B distribution.

products.name: Electronic Design Automation (EDA) Solutions
products.description: Comprehensive software and hardware tools for designing, verifying, and manufacturing integrated circuits (ICs), including digital and custom IC design, FPGA design, verification, manufacturing, and AI-driven EDA solutions. Delivered as on-premises software, cloud-based SaaS, and hardware systems.

products.name: Semiconductor Intellectual Property (IP) Solutions
products.description: Pre-designed, silicon-proven IP blocks and subsystems for use in system-on-chip (SoC) and multi-die designs, including interface IP, logic libraries, embedded memories, processor cores, security IP, and IP implementation services. Delivered as licensed IP and design consulting services.

products.name: Simulation and Analysis (S&A) Software (Ansys Portfolio)
products.description: Engineering simulation software for structural, electronics, fluids, optics, photonics, and multiphysics analysis, enabling virtual testing and optimization of products across industries. Delivered as on-premises or cloud-based software subscriptions or perpetual licenses.

products.name: Design and Engineering Consulting Services
products.description: Professional services including consulting, design assistance, and expert training for all phases of SoC and electronic system development, as well as workshops on EDA tools and methodologies. Delivered by in-person or remote engineering teams.

products.name: Verification Hardware and Prototyping Systems
products.description: Hardware systems for emulation and FPGA-based prototyping, enabling accelerated verification, early software development, and system validation of complex SoCs. Delivered as physical hardware products sold or leased to customers.

products.name: Mechatronic and Optical Simulation Software
products.description: Software tools for mechatronic system simulation and optical design, including modeling of mechanical, electrical, and optical systems. (Note: Optical Solutions Group was divested in October 2025.)

products.name: University and Academic Program Products
products.description: Specialized versions of software and tools provided to universities and academic institutions for education and research purposes. Delivered as licensed software and programmatic offerings.

products.name: Investment Advisory Services
products.description: Provision of discretionary investment management and advisory services to mutual funds and exchange-traded funds (ETFs), including portfolio construction, security selection, and execution of trades, under regulated advisory agreements. Delivered by professional portfolio teams and subject to regulatory oversight.

products.name: Administrative Services for Mutual Funds
products.description: Provision of administrative, supervisory, and operational management services to mutual funds, including oversight of fund affairs and compliance, under annual administrative services agreements. Delivered through in-person and regulated processes.

products.name: Copper Products
products.description: Copper is produced and sold in three main forms: copper concentrate, copper cathode, and continuous cast copper rod. Production involves large-scale mining, physical ore processing (crushing, milling, leaching), smelting, refining, and casting, with facilities in the U.S., South America, and Indonesia. Products are delivered to industrial customers globally via contracts and spot sales.

products.name: Gold Products
products.description: Gold is produced primarily as a by-product from copper mining, especially at the Grasberg minerals district in Indonesia. Gold is recovered through mining, milling, smelting, and refining processes, and is sold as gold bars or as a component in copper concentrate and anode slimes to global markets.

products.name: Molybdenum Products and Chemicals
products.description: Molybdenum is produced from dedicated molybdenum mines (Climax and Henderson) and as a by-product from copper mines. The company processes molybdenum concentrate into technical-grade molybdic oxide, ferromolybdenum, ammonium molybdates, and other chemical products at its own conversion facilities in the U.S. and Europe, supplying steel, chemical, and electronics industries.

products.name: Sulfuric Acid
products.description: Sulfuric acid is produced as a by-product of copper smelting operations, particularly at the Miami smelter and Safford mine. It is used internally for leaching but also sold externally to third parties, especially when production exceeds internal requirements.

products.name: Electronic Materials Recycling Services
products.description: Through Atlantic Copper, the company is developing an e-material recycling project to recover copper, gold, silver, palladium, tin, nickel, and platinum from electronic waste. This involves adding a smelting furnace and associated equipment to existing facilities, with operations expected to commence in 2026.

products.name: Gaming Hardware and Accessories
products.description: Sale of new and pre-owned gaming consoles (e.g., Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X) and related accessories such as controllers and headsets, through physical retail stores and ecommerce platforms. Products are sourced from major manufacturers and distributed via a global logistics network.

products.name: Gaming Software and Digital Content
products.description: Sale of new and pre-owned gaming software for current and prior generation consoles, including physical games, digital downloads, and in-game digital currency, delivered via retail stores and online platforms.

products.name: Collectibles and Pop Culture Merchandise
products.description: Sale of collectibles including apparel, toys, trading cards, gadgets, and other pop culture and technology-themed products, offered through specialized stores and ecommerce. Includes both branded and third-party merchandise.

products.name: Trade-In and Refurbishment Services
products.description: Provision of trade-in programs for pre-owned gaming, mobility, and collectible products, including refurbishment, repair, and resale of used items through dedicated centers and retail locations.

products.name: Loyalty Program Memberships
products.description: Operation of free and paid customer loyalty programs that provide exclusive rewards, discounts, and benefits across retail and ecommerce channels. Memberships are sold directly to consumers and drive repeat business.

products.name: Solar Panel Recycling and Materials Recovery Solutions
products.description: Comstock operates demonstration and industry-scale facilities that recycle end-of-life solar panels, recovering and selling high-value materials such as aluminum, glass pearls, and concentrated tailings containing silver, silicon, copper, and other critical and electrification metals. This involves physical processing and refining at specialized facilities.

products.name: Renewable Fuels and Biomass Conversion Technologies
products.description: Through its Bioleum subsidiary, Comstock develops, operates, and licenses technologies that convert waste, energy crops, and woody biomass into intermediates for advanced renewable fuels such as SAF, renewable diesel, and cellulosic ethanol. Delivery includes direct operation of refineries and technology licensing to partners.

products.name: Precious Metals Mining and Royalties
products.description: Comstock owns, controls, and manages gold and silver mining assets in Nevada, including mining claims and surface parcels, and generates revenue through direct mining operations and royalty interests. This involves regulated extraction and processing of mineral resources.

products.name: Technology Licensing for Renewable Metals and Fuels
products.description: Comstock licenses its proprietary and patented technologies for renewable metals recovery and renewable fuels production to external partners, enabling them to deploy these solutions in their own operations. This is a digital and intellectual property-based offering.

products.name: Industrial Waste Management Services
products.description: Comstock provides industrial waste management services, including decommissioning and environmental remediation for end-of-life solar panels and other industrial waste streams, generating revenue through service and tipping fees. This requires in-person labor and regulated infrastructure.
